blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Temporal medical image segmentation relies on pixel-wise annotations, which are prohibitively expensive for long image sequences. Existing weakly-supervised methods reduce the annotation burden per frame but still require repeated annotations across the sequence. Furthermore, sparse supervision can result in temporally unstable representations. Addressing both challenges requires a model that can leverage strong spatial priors from large-scale pretraining while minimizing reliance on dense annotations. Frozen 2D vision foundation models provide a promising basis for this by offering transferable spatial representations with low trainable parameters. However, their lack of explicit temporal modeling limits their ability to propagate reliable information across anatomical sequences. To address this, we present a weakly-supervised framework for temporal segmentation from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework combines parameter-efficient adaptation of DINOv3 encoders present in the mean-teacher architecture. Furthermore, a set of complementary losses, including a temporal loss helps generate reliable segmentation priors for the unlabeled frames. This formulation decouples annotation costs from sequence length while retaining the transferable spatial knowledge of the pretrained encoder. Extensive experiments on the publicly available CAMUS and CardiacNet datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms other scribble-supervised methods. These results show that accurate and temporally consistent segmentation can be achieved from extremely sparse supervision, substantially reducing annotation requirements for temporal echocardiographic segmentation and providing a practical framework for scalable clinical deployment.
blocks.zh: 暂时的医学影像分解依赖于像素相向的注释,对于长相影像序列来说,这些注释过于昂贵. 现有的由薄弱监督的方法减轻了每个框架的注释负担,但仍需要在整个序列中重复说明。 此外,监督很少会导致暂时不稳定的表述。 应对这两项挑战需要一种模式,能够利用大规模预训产生的强大的空间前兆,同时尽量减少对密集说明的依赖。 冻结的2D愿景基础模型为此提供了一个有希望的基础,提供了具有低可训练参数的可转移空间表示. 然而,它们缺乏明确的时间模型,限制了它们在解剖序列中传播可靠信息的能力。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了一个由薄弱监督的框架,用于从一个被附加了说明的单一框架进行时间分解,所有剩余框架都未加标签。 该框架结合了中间-教师架构中存在的DINOv3编码器的参数效率改造. 此外,包括时间损失在内的一系列补充损失有助于为无标签的框架产生可靠的分块前兆。 这种配方使注释与序列长度脱钩,同时保留了被预先训练的编码器的可转让空间知识. 对可公开获取的CAMUS和CardiacNet数据集的广泛实验表明,我们的方法比其他有文字监督的方法要好。 这些结果表明,通过极少数的监管,可以实现准确和时间上一致的分解,大大减少了时间回声心分解的注释要求,并为可扩展的临床部署提供了实用框架.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Segmentation of temporal medical sequences is vital in many clinical applications, as it enables consistent quantification and tracking of anatomical and pathological changes over time [ 2 , 23 , 19 ] . However, achieving reliable sequence segmentation remains constrained by the annotation bottleneck. Methods achieving high segmentation performance conventionally rely on dense pixel-wise annotations for every frame, while obtaining such large-scale annotations in clinical settings remains a significant challenge [ 22 , 20 ] . This challenge is particularly pronounced in echocardiography, where speckle noise obscures anatomical boundaries and adjacent tissues can exhibit similar acoustic properties, making structures difficult to distinguish without expert interpretation [ 6 , 24 ] . Consequently, annotation of echocardiographic sequences is both time-consuming and dependent on specialist expertise, with annotation effort increasing with every additional frame in a sequence.
blocks.zh: 分解时间医学序列在许多临床应用中至关重要,因为它能够对一段时间内解剖学和病理学的变化进行一致的量化和跟踪[2,23,19]. 然而,实现可靠的序列分割仍然受到注释瓶颈的限制。 实现高分解性能的方法通常依赖于每个帧的密集像素-视像素-注释,同时在临床环境中获得如此大规模的注释仍然是一项重大挑战[22,20]. 这一挑战在回声心电图中尤为突出,光谱噪声模糊了解剖边界,相邻组织也能够表现出类似的声学特性,使得结构难以在没有专家解释的情况下区分[6,24]. 因此,对回声心电图序列的注释既费时又取决于专家的专门知识,随着每个附加框架的排列顺序而增加注释工作。

blocks.en: Current methods that reduce annotation requirements can broadly be divided into two categories. Semi-supervised learning (SSL) combines a small subset of densely annotated frames with a larger set of unlabeled frames, as shown in Mean Teacher [ 21 ] and Cross Pseudo Supervision (CPS) [ 5 ] . The labeled subset provides direct supervision through segmentation losses, while the unlabeled subset provides consistency regularization [ 13 ] that encourages reliable and temporally coherent predictions. Weakly-supervised learning (WSL), in contrast, replaces dense masks with coarse annotations such as bounding boxes [ 9 , 15 , 8 ] , points [ 30 , 27 ] or scribbles [ 3 , 1 , 4 ] , typically provided on every training frame. These approaches reduce annotation burden in different ways. SSL reduces the number of frames requiring dense annotation while WSL reduces the amount of annotation required per frame. However, both remain dependent on annotations across the sequence, so annotation effort continues to increase with sequence length.
blocks.zh: 目前减少注释要求的方法大致可分为两类. 半监督学习(SSL)结合了一小段密集注解的帧和更大的一组无标签的帧,如Mean Teach [21]和Cross Pseudo Professoring (CPS) [5]所示. 标签子集通过分块损失提供直接监督,而无标签子集则提供一致性正规化[13],鼓励可靠和时间一致性的预测. 弱监督学习(WSL),相对而言,用粗细的说明代替密集的口罩,如边框[9,15,8],点[30,27]或写[3,1,4],通常在每个训练框架中提供. 这些办法以不同方式减轻了注解负担。 SSL减少需要密集注释的帧数,而WSL则减少每个帧需要注释的数量. 然而,两者仍然依赖于全序的注解,因此注解努力继续随着序列长度的增加而增加.

blocks.en: To address this limitation, we propose a weakly-supervised framework for segmenting echocardiographic sequences from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework consists of three complementary components that convert sparse spatial supervision into reliable sequence-wide segmentation. Firstly, a mean-teacher framework generates dense pseudo-labels and propagates supervision outward from the annotated frame in a bidirectional manner. Secondly, a frozen DINOv3-based [ 18 ] encoder, adapted to medical images using Low-rank Adaptations (LoRA) [ 7 ] provides transferable spatial representations while restricting adaptation to a small number of trainable parameters. The representations are fed into a lightweight U-Net-style decoder [ 16 ] , keeping trainable parameters low. Thirdly, complementary spatial and temporal losses enforce consistency across the sequence while allowing anatomically plausible changes in cardiac shape.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一限制,我们提议建立一个由薄弱监督的框架,将回声心学序列从一个单一的书写附加说明的框架中分割开来,所有剩余的框架都未加标签。 框架由三个互补部分组成,它们将稀疏的空间监督转化为可靠的全序分化. 首先,中度教师框架产生密集的假标签,并以双向方式从附加说明的框架向外传播监督。 第二,一个冷冻的基于DINov3的[18]编码器,利用低级适应(LORA)[7]的医学图像进行改造,提供可转移的空间表示,同时限制适应少数可训练参数. 表示器被输入轻量级的U-Net型解码器[16],使可训练参数保持低水平. 第三,互补性的空间和时间损失加强了整个序列的一致性,同时允许心脏形状发生解剖上可信的变化。

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed framework on two publicly available datasets, Cardiac Acquisitions for Multi-structure Ultrasound Segmentation (CAMUS) [ 10 ] and CardiacNet [ 25 ] , spanning three different cohorts. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing scribble-supervised baselines in both Dice and HD95 metrics, while achieving a more favorable balance between precision and recall. These results show that accurate and spatially well-localized temporal segmentation can be achieved from only one scribble-annotated frame, substantially reducing annotation requirements for echocardiographic sequence segmentation. Our key contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于两个公开可用的数据集的拟议框架,即多结构超声波分片(CAMUS)[10]和CardiacNet[25],涉及三个不同的组别。 实验结果表明,我们的方法在Dice和HD95度度量中一直比现有的有条理监督的基线要好,同时在精确度和召回度之间取得更有利的平衡。 这些结果表明,只有一个字母附加说明的框架可以实现准确和空间上位置良好的时间分化,从而大大减少了回声心动序列分化的注释要求。 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose a weakly-supervised temporal segmentation framework for medical imaging sequences based on single slice scribble annotations on the middle frame. • We demonstrate that a LoRA-adapted foundation model encoder can improve segmentation performance with significantly fewer parameters compared to state-of-the-art scribble segmentation methods • We also propose an anchor-relative bidirectional temporal loss, L t ​ e ​ m ​ p L_{temp} , that can propagate supervision outward from the anchor frame in both directions while allowing for drifting so that segmentation masks follow the natural progression of anatomical structures.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们根据中间框架的单片条状说明,提出医疗成像序列的弱监督时间分解框架。 我们证明,一个经过LORA调整的基础模型编码器可以改进分解性能,与最先进的分解方法相比,分解性能要小得多。 我们也提出双向双向时间损失(L t e mi p_{temp}L t e e mi p_{temp}),可以将双向锚架上的监管向外传播,同时允许漂移,使分解口罩随解剖结构的自然发展而出现.

blocks.en: We propose a weakly-supervised temporal segmentation framework for medical imaging sequences based on single slice scribble annotations on the middle frame.
blocks.zh: 我们根据中框上单片的书写说明,提出医学成像序列的弱监督时间分解框架.

blocks.en: We demonstrate that a LoRA-adapted foundation model encoder can improve segmentation performance with significantly fewer parameters compared to state-of-the-art scribble segmentation methods
blocks.zh: 我们证明,一个经过LORA调整的基础模型编码器可以改善分解性能,与最先进的分解方法相比,参数要少得多。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Scribble-supervised Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 书写监督 分割

blocks.en: Scribble-supervised segmentation addresses the problem of learning dense segmentation masks from sparse pixel annotations. Common methods such as partial cross-entropy (pCE) compute the supervised loss only over annotated pixels but do not extend supervision to unlabeled regions. Therefore, existing scribble-supervised methods extend sparse scribbles through augmentation, consistency regularization and architectural modifications.
blocks.zh: Scrible监督的分割处理从稀疏的像素说明中学习密集分割口罩的问题. 普通方法,如部分交叉连接(pCE),只计算附加说明的像素上的监督损失,但不将监督扩大到无标签的区域。 因此,现有的书写监督方法通过增强、一致性规范化和建筑改造,扩展了稀有的书写。

blocks.en: Augmentation-based methods perturb the training samples and enforce consistency between the corresponding predictions. CutMix [ 26 ] constructs a new training sample by combining regions from two images, with the corresponding labels mixed using the same spatial transformation. This exposes the model to additional combinations of foreground and background regions while preserving the available sparse supervision. CycleMix [ 28 ] extends mixed-sample augmentation with cycle-consistency constraints, using complementary transformed views to exploit information from both labeled and unlabeled regions. Together, these strategies encourage predictions to remain consistent under input perturbations.
blocks.zh: 基于增强的方法干扰了培训样本,并加强了相应预测的一致性。 CutMix [26]通过将两个图像的区域组合起来,构建一个新的训练样本,相应的标签混合使用相同的空间变换. 这使该模式暴露在前景和背景区域的额外组合中,同时保留了现有的稀缺监管. CycleMix [28] 以周期一致性约束延伸混合-样本增强,利用互补的转变观点利用来自标签区和无标签区的信息. 这些战略共同鼓励预测在投入扰动时保持一致。

blocks.en: Architecture-based approaches instead modify the segmentation framework to better exploit the limited spatial supervision. ScribFormer [ 12 ] combines a convolutional branch with a transformer branch and a class-activation branch to integrate local appearance with global contextual information, allowing the network to infer object structure beyond the annotated scribbles. Other methods combine architectural changes with consistency-based training. HELPNet [ 29 ] introduces hierarchical perturbations at multiple spatial granularity and enforces consistency between the resulting predictions, together with edge-guided refinement to improve boundaries that are not directly specified by the scribble. Despite different mechanisms, these methods process frames independently and require scribble annotations throughout the sequence, causing annotation cost to scale with sequence length.
blocks.zh: 以结构为基础的办法则修改了划分框架,以便更好地利用有限的空间监督。 ScribFormer [12]将一个革命分支与变压器分支和类激活分支结合,将局部外观与全局背景信息融合,使网络可以推断附加注释的字形以外的物体结构. 其他方法将建筑改革与基于一致性的培训结合起来. HelpNet [29] 在多个空间颗粒性上引入了分级扰动,并强制进行所得出的预测之间的一致性,同时进行边缘引导的改进,以改善没有被拼写直接指定的边界. 尽管机制不同,这些方法处理框架是独立的,需要在整个序列中写作说明,导致注释成本随序列长度而缩放.

blocks.en: 2.2 Vision Foundation Models and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2 愿景基础模型和参数有效适应

blocks.en: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining has produced vision backbones with transferable representations that can be reused across downstream tasks with limited task-specific supervision [ 11 ] . DINOv3 extends this capability through large-scale self-supervised pretraining, providing spatial representations that can be transferred to domains where labeled data are scarce. We use a general-purpose DINOv3 rather than an echocardiography-specific foundation model so that the supervision scheme remains modality-agnostic rather than tied to a single domain.
blocks.zh: 大规模自我监督的预训产生了具有可转移表达功能的愿景骨干,可以在有限的特定任务监督下跨下游任务重复使用[11]. DINOv3通过大规模自我监督的预训来扩展这种能力,提供空间表现,可以转移到标签数据稀缺的领域. 我们使用通用的DINOv3,而不是回声心电图专用的基础模型,这样,监督计划仍然具有模式不可知性,而不是与单一领域挂钩。

blocks.en: Adapting large pretrained backbones to a target medical domain introduces a second challenge. Full fine-tuning of all backbone parameters increases computational cost and risk of overfitting [ 17 ] . Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods instead preserve most of the pretrained representation while restricting task-specific adaptation to a small number of parameters. LoRA introduces trainable low-rank updates into selected linear projections while keeping the original pretrained weights fixed, substantially reducing the number of trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 将经过预先培训的大型骨干调整到目标医疗领域带来了第二个挑战。 对所有骨干参数进行全面微调,提高计算成本和超配风险[17]. 参数效率微调(PEFT)方法反而保留了大多数预先训练过的表示,同时将特定任务调整限制在少数参数内. LoRA将可训练低等级更新引入选定的线性预测,同时保持原有的预训练重量固定,大大减少可训练参数的数量.

blocks.en: 3.3 Parameter-Efficient Encoding and Multi-Scale Decoding
blocks.zh: 3.3 参数有效编码和多尺度解码

blocks.en: A frozen DINOv3 encoder is adapted using LoRA on the query and value projections of three transformer blocks, introducing 27.6 27.6 K trainable parameters corresponding to 0.03 % 0.03\% of the 85.7 85.7 M while preserving the pretrained representation under sparse supervision. Patch tokens are extracted from the three adapted blocks. Each token corresponds to a 16 × 16 16\times 16 pixel patch so a 512 × 512 512\times 512 input yields a grid of 32 × 32 32\times 32 tokens. Since the transformer block applies no spatial downsampling, all three LoRA block readouts share this resolution and differ only in semantic depth. They are resampled to strides 4 4 , 8 8 and 16 16 , producing 128 × 128 128\times 128 , 64 × 64 64\times 64 and 32 × 32 32\times 32 spatial feature maps. A fourth level at stride 32 32 is obtained by average pooling the stride- 16 16 map to 16 × 16 16\times 16 , which provides the decoder a coarser representation and a larger effective receptive field.
blocks.zh: 一个冷冻的DINOv3编码器在3个变压器块的查询和值预测上使用LORA进行改造,引入了27.6 27.6 K 可列车参数相当于85.7 85.7型机车的0.03%. M,同时在很少的监督下保留经过预先训练的代表。 从三个经过改造的区块中提取补丁符号. 每个符号对应一个16×16 16\时16像素补丁,所以一个512×512 512\时512输入的网格产生32×32 32\时32的符号. 由于变压器块没有进行空间下采样,所有三个LORA块读出都分享这个分辨率,并且只在语义深度上有所不同. 它们被重印到4 4,8 8和16 16步,生成128 × 128\time 128,64 × 64\time 64和32 × 32\time 32 空间特征图. 第4层为第32层,通过平均汇集16 16幅地图至16 × 16 16\16时16分,为解码器提供了凝固器代表和一个更大的有效可接受领域。

blocks.en: Each pyramid level is independently projected using a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution followed by group normalization and ReLU. The projected features are then passed to a U-Net style decoder, beginning at stride- 32 32 level and progressively upsampled through three stages. At each stage, the upsampled decoder features are concatenated with the corresponding projected feature map from the pyramid. The final decoder output is converted to segmentation logits and bilinearly resized to the original input resolution.
blocks.zh: 每个金字塔级别都采用1×1 1\time 1的演化进行独立预测,随后是群体正常化和ReLU. 然后将预测的特征传递给U-Net风格的解码器,从32-32级开始,并逐步提升到三个阶段。 在每个阶段,上标的解码器特征都与来自金字塔的相应预测特征图相配合. 最终的解码器输出被转换为分区对数,双线性地调整为原始输入分辨率.

blocks.en: 3.4 Dense Supervision from Single Scribble-annotated Frame
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 单笔说明式监督 框架

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Mean Teacher Construction and Scribble Supervision
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 教师平均建筑和文字监督

blocks.en: The framework maintains structurally identical student and teacher branches. The student is optimized directly through gradient descent while the teacher parameters are updated as an exponential moving average (EMA) of the student parameters. Since the DINOv3 backbone is frozen throughout training, its pretrained weights are shared between the two branches, while the LoRA adapters, feature projections and segmentation decoder are maintained separately and updated through the corresponding student and teacher mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 该框架在结构上维持了完全相同的学生和教师分支。 学生通过梯度下降直接优化,而教师参数作为学生参数的指数移动平均值(EMA)更新. 由于DINOv3主干线在整个培训过程中被冻结,其预训重量由两个分支共享,而LORA适配器,特征预测和分区解码器则通过相应的师生机制单独维护和更新.

blocks.en: For each training sequence, the student receives a weakly augmented view generated using brightness and contrast perturbations together with additive noise. These transformations modify image appearance while preserving spatial geometry, ensuring pixel-wise alignment between the student predictions and the supervision generated from the unaugmented sequence.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on two publicly available echocardiography datasets, CAMUS and CardiacNet. All datasets are divided into training, validation and test sets using a 70:10:20 ratio. CAMUS contains echocardiographic sequences from 500 patients, from which we use the two-chamber (2CH) half-sequence subset. Ground-truth masks are provided for all frames, so the mask-derived scribble annotations is on the middle frame of the sequence. Performance is evaluated on three anatomical structures namely the left-ventricular endocardium ( L ​ V e ​ n ​ d ​ o LV_{endo} ), left-ventricular epicardium ( L ​ V e ​ p ​ i LV_{epi} ) and left atrium.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个公开的回声心电图数据集CAMUS和心电图网评估我们的方法。 所有数据集都采用70:10:20的比例分为培训,验证和测试集. CAMUS包含来自500位患者的回声心律序列,我们从中使用两组(2CH)半序列子集. 所有帧都提供地面真伪口罩,因此口罩衍生的拼写说明在序列的中框上. 对三个解剖结构,即左心内膜(LV e n d o LV_{ndo}),左心内膜(LV e p i LV_{epi})和左心内膜,进行性能评价.

blocks.en: CardiacNet comprises two pathology-specific cohorts: atrial septal defect (ASD) and pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Segmentation masks are released for only a subset of the acquired sequences and a small number of the released files could not be read. We therefore use every sequence for which a usable annotation exists, giving 135 ASD and 299 PAH sequences. Unlike CAMUS, ground-truth masks are provided for approximately five frames within each sequence, so the scribble is placed on the middle annotated frame rather than the middle frame of the sequence. Both cohorts are evaluated on four cardiac structures: left ventricle (LV), left atrium (LA), right ventricle (RV) and right atrium (RA). Across both datasets, training supervision is restricted to one background and one foreground scribble with all remaining frames unlabeled.
blocks.zh: 心血管网络包括两个病理学上特有的群体:先天分裂缺陷(ASD)和肺动脉高血压(PAH)。 片段口罩只为获取序列的子集发布,少数发布文件无法读取. 因此,我们使用存在可用注释的每个序列,给出135个ASD和299个PAH序列。 与CAMUS不同的是,每个序列中都提供了大约五个帧的地面真假面具,因此拼写版被放在中注的帧上,而不是序列的中框. 两个组别都通过四个心脏结构进行评估:左心管(LV)、左心管(LA)、右心管(RV)和右心管(RA)。 在整个两个数据集中,培训监督仅限于一个背景和一个前景,所有剩余框架没有标记。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节

blocks.en: All experiments were implemented in PyTorch with Python 3.12 and CUDA 13.2 and conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell GPU. We use DINOv3 ViT-B/16 as the vision foundation model backbone, with rank-3 LoRA adapters applied to the query and value projections of transformer blocks 3, 6 and 9. Single-channel ultrasound frames are used across three channels, resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 , and normalized using the ImageNet channel-wise mean and standard deviation.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都与PyTorch 3.12和CUDA 13.2一起在PyTorch进行,并在单NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell GPU上进行. 我们使用DINOv3 VIT-B/16作为视野基础模型骨干,等级-3 LoRA适配器适用于变压器3,6和9区块的查询和值预测. 单通道超声波帧跨越三个频道使用,大小调整为512×512 512\times 512,并使用ImageNet频道的正差和标准偏差实现常态化.

blocks.en: Models are trained for 40 epochs using AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , weight decay of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} and mixed-precision training. The partial cross-entropy, Dice, temporal consistency and gated-CRF losses are weighted by 1.0 1.0 , 0.5 0.5 , 0.1 0.1 and 0.1 0.1 respectively. The weights of the three unsupervised objectives are linearly ramped from zero to their respective values over the first five epochs. The teacher parameters are updated using an EMA decay of 0.99 0.99 and the connectivity-filtered teacher and student predictions are mixed using a pixel-wise Bernoulli mask with β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 .
blocks.zh: 对使用 AdamW 的 40 个纪元进行模型培训,学习率为 1× 10− 4 1\times 10× 4}体重衰减为 1× 10− 4 1\times 10× 4}以及混合精度培训. 部分跨直径、双眼、时间一致性和闸门-通用报告格式损失分别加权1.01.0、0.50.5、0.10.1和0.10.1。 三个无监督目标的权重在前五个纪元上从零线向各自的数值线性提升. 师资参数采用0.099 0.99的EMA衰变进行更新,互联互通过滤的师生预测采用像素-明智的伯努利口罩,β=0.5\β=0.5.

blocks.en: 4.3 Baseline and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线和评价计量

blocks.en: We compare our method against a U-Net trained with pCE alone and four scribble-supervised methods: CutMix, CycleMix, ScribFormer and HELPNet. A consistent evaluation protocol is applied across all methods, with performance measured on all frames with available ground-truth annotations to assess generalization beyond the annotated frame. We report the Dice similarity coefficient and 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95), together with precision and recall to further characterize segmentation errors.
blocks.zh: 我们比较我们的方法与一个仅用PCE 和四种可书写监督的方法训练的U-Net:CutMix,CycleMix,ScribFormer和HelpNet。 在所有方法中都采用一致的评价协议,在所有框架上测量业绩,并附上可用的地面真实说明,以评估附加说明框架之外的概况。 我们报告Dice相似系数和95百分位的Husdorff距离(HD95),并报告精确度和召回度,以进一步说明分区误差的特征。

blocks.en: Tab. 1 shows that our method achieves the highest average Dice across all three cohorts, with scores of 0.784 0.784 , 0.744 0.744 , and 0.754 0.754 on CAMUS, CardiacNet-ASD and CardiacNet-PAH respectively. Performance is lowest on the CardiacNet-ASD cohort, where the septal defect disrupts the normal boundary between the atria, increasing ambiguity in chamber delineation. Compared to consistency-based methods, our method improves over CutMix by 0.097 0.097 , 0.338 0.338 , and 0.192 0.192 Dice respectively. The improvement over dedicated scribble-supervised methods is larger, particularly on CardiacNet. While ScribFormer and HELPNet achieve competitive performance on some CAMUS structures, their average Dice remains low on both CardiacNet cohorts, indicating poor generalization while our method achieves 0.744 0.744 on CardiacNet-ASD and 0.754 0.754 on CardiacNet-PAH. Overall, our method achieves the highest Dice on 10 10 of 11 11 structures, demonstrating more consistent performance under single-frame scribble supervision. It also shows that our method achieves the lowest average HD95 across all three cohorts, with 31.25 31.25 , 41.72 41.72 , and 28.30 28.30 pixels on CAMUS, CardiacNet-ASD, and CardiacNet-PAH respectively. Consistent with the Dice results, CardiacNet-ASD remains the most challenging cohort, although our method maintains considerably lower boundary errors across all four structures.
blocks.zh: 标签1显示,我们的方法在所有三个组别中都取得了最高的平均二分,在CAMUS、CardiacNet-ASD和CardiacNet-PAH上的得分分别为0.784 0.784 0.744 0.754 0.754 。 在心动网-ASD组中,性能最低,其中的缝隙缺陷干扰了阿特里亚之间的正常边界,增加了室内划界的模糊性. 与基于一致性的方法相比,我们的方法比CutMix改进了0.097 0.097,0.338 0.338,0.192 0.192 分别ice. 与专用的书写监督方法相比,改进程度更大,特别是在心脏病网。 虽然ScribFormer和HelpNet在一些CAMUS结构上取得了竞争表现,但它们在CadiacNet两个组中的平均Dice仍然很低,这表明通用性差,而我们的方法在CadiacNet-ASD上达到0.744 0.744,在CadiacNet-PAH上达到0.754 0.754。 总的来说,我们的方法在11个结构中的10个结构上实现了最高的Dice,显示出在单帧书写监督下更一贯的性能. 这还表明,我们的方法在所有三个组别中平均达到最低的HD95,分别是31.25 31.25、41.72 41.72和28.30 28.30像素的CAMUS、CardiacNet-ASD和CardiacNet-PAH。 根据Dice结果,CardiacNet-ASD仍然是最具挑战性的一组,尽管我们的方法在所有四个结构中都保持了相当较低的边界差错。

blocks.en: Given the substantial performance gap observed in both Dice and HD95, we further investigate why existing methods degrade under single-frame supervision. As illustrated in Figs. 2 , 3 and 4 , their poor performance is primarily driven by severe over-segmentation rather than localized boundary errors, with predictions extending substantially beyond the target anatomy. This explains the low Dice and high HD95 observed in the quantitative results. To better characterize this failure mode, we additionally analyze precision and recall in Tab. 2 .
blocks.zh: 鉴于在Dice和HD95中都观察到了巨大的性能差距,我们进一步调查现行方法为何在单一框架监督下退化。 如图所示。 2, 3, 4, 它们的不良性能主要受到严重分化而非局部边界误差的驱动,预测大大超出了目标解剖学的范围. 这解释了在定量结果中观察到的低剂量和高HD95的原因. 为了更好地描述这种失败模式,我们在Tab中进一步分析精度和召回. 2 (英语).

blocks.en: Tab. 2 further corroborates this failure mode. The pCE baseline, CycleMix and ScribFormer consistently exhibit high recall but extremely low precision, particularly on the two CardiacNet cohorts. This pattern shows over-segmentation, where predicted masks cover large regions of the image, leading to substantial overlap with the ground truth mask. Thus, recall values are inflated despite poor localization quality. In contrast, our framework improves precision while maintaining competitive recall, with precision consistently exceeding recall across all three cohorts. Overall, the improvements in Dice and HD95 can be attributed primarily to a reduction in false-positive predictions rather than increased anatomical coverage, consistent with the qualitative segmentation results.
blocks.zh: 标签2进一步证实了这种失败模式. PCE基线,CycleMix和ScribFormer,一直显示出很高的召回率,但精度极低,特别是在两个心网组中。 这种图案显示过于分化,其中预测的口罩覆盖了图像的大片区域,导致与地面真相口罩的大量重叠. 因此,尽管本地化质量差,但召回值却被夸大。 相比之下,我们的框架提高了准确度,同时保持了竞争性召回,在所有三个组别中,精确度一直超过召回。 总体而言,Dice和HD95的改进主要可归因于假阳性预测的减少,而不是符合定性分解结果的解剖覆盖率的提高.

blocks.en: 5 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5项

blocks.en: All ablation experiments are conducted on the CAMUS dataset using the LV endocardium. CAMUS is selected as ground-truth masks are available for every frame so metrics can be computed on the entire sequence, enabling a more comprehensive evaluation of temporal segmentation performance. The LV endocardium is used as a representative structure to systematically isolate the contribution of each component in the proposed framework. We evaluate the effects of the architectural design, LoRA adaptation, mean-teacher framework and individual loss terms.
blocks.zh: 利用LV内分泌在CAMUS数据集上进行所有消毒实验。 CAMUS被选为每个帧都有地面真实的口罩,因此可以按整个序列计算指标,从而能够更全面地评价时间分解性能。 LV内分泌被用作一种代表性结构,系统地隔离拟议框架中每个组成部分的贡献。 我们评价建筑设计、LORA改造、平均教师框架和个人损失条款的影响。

blocks.en: 5.1 Effectiveness of Architecture
blocks.zh: 5.1 结构的有效性

blocks.en: We further examine the depth of the feature pyramid by reducing it from four to three levels, removing the coarsest scale while keeping the frozen DINOv3 encoder and all other components unchanged. The three-level model decreases Dice from 0.824 0.824 to 0.734 0.734 on CAMUS and from 0.779 0.779 to 0.763 0.763 on CardiacNet-PAH. The coarsest level aggregates information over a larger area of the image, allowing the decoder to reason about global shape and spatial relationships between structures, which cannot be inferred from local appearance alone. Without this level, the decoder must recover such context from finer scales that look at smaller areas, so spatially separated regions are processed largely independently. This is particularly detrimental under scribble supervision, where most pixels and unlabeled and the network must rely on global shape priors to extend sparse annotations to complete, anatomically plausible masks.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步检查地物金字塔的深度,将它从4级减少到3级,去掉最粗的尺度,同时保持冷冻的DINOv3编码器和所有其他组件不变. 三级模式减少 在CAMUS上从0.824 0.824到0.734 0.734,在CardiacNet-PAH上从0.779 0.779到0.763 0.763。 相距最短的电位将信息汇总到图像更大的区域上,使解码器能够对全局形状和结构之间的空间关系进行推理,而光靠局部外观是无法推断的. 没有这一级别,解码器必须从更细的尺度中恢复这种上下文,看小区域,因此空间分离的区域基本上独立处理. 在写作的监督下,这是特别有害的,因为大多数像素和无标签,网络必须依靠全球形状的前身来扩展稀疏的说明以完成解剖学上可信的面具。

blocks.en: 5.2 Effectiveness of LoRA
blocks.zh: 5.2 LORA的有效性

blocks.en: Removing the low-rank adapters reduces Dice from 0.824 0.824 to 0.784 0.784 on CAMUS and from 0.779 0.779 to 0.771 0.771 on CardiacNet-PAH. The improvement on CAMUS indicates that adapting the pretrained DINOv3 features is important for capturing echocardiographic characteristics such as low-contrast boundaries and speckle patterns.
blocks.zh: 删除低级适配器减少 在CAMUS上从0.824 0.824到0.784 0.784,在CardiacNet-PAH上从0.779 0.779到0.771 0.771。 对CAMUS的改进表明,调整预先训练的DINOv3特征对于捕捉低相隔边界和光谱图样等回声心学特征很重要.

blocks.en: 5.3 Effectiveness of Mean Teacher Framework
blocks.zh: 5.3 平均教师框架的有效性

blocks.en: Removing the EMA teacher while retaining all other components reduces Dice from 0.824 0.824 to 0.799 0.799 on CAMUS and from 0.779 0.779 to 0.772 0.772 on CardiacNet-PAH. The consistent reduction across both datasets demonstrates the benefit of maintaining a temporally averaged teacher. Without EMA updates, both branches adapt directly to similar training signals, reducing the diversity and stability of the predictions used to construct the mixed pseudo-labels. The mean-teacher framework provides a more stable teacher that evolves smoothly over training, complementing the faster-adapting student. This produces more reliable consistency targets and improves segmentation under limited supervision.
blocks.zh: 取消EMA教师,同时保留所有其他组件,将Dice从CAMUS上的0.824 0.824减少到0.799 0.79 0.779减少到心网-PAH上的0.772 0.772 0.772。 两个数据集的不断减少表明保持一个按时间平均的教师的好处。 没有EMA更新,两个分支直接适应类似的训练信号,降低了用于构建混合伪标签的预测的多样性和稳定性. 平均教师框架提供了一个较稳定的教师,比培训更顺利地发展,补充适应更快的学生。 这产生了更可靠的一致性目标,并在有限的监督下改进了分割。

blocks.en: 5.4 Effectiveness of Losses
blocks.zh: 5.4 损失的有效性

blocks.en: The loss ablation demonstrates the contribution of each supervision component across both datasets. Using only the partial cross-entropy loss, L p ​ C ​ E L_{pCE} , results in Dice scores of 0.613 0.613 on CAMUS and 0.410 0.410 on CardiacNet-PAH, showing that sparse scribble annotations contain insufficient supervision information. Adding the consistency loss L c ​ o ​ n ​ s L_{cons} substantially improves segmentation performance to 0.770 0.770 and 0.626 0.626 respectively, demonstrating the importance of exploiting pseudo-label supervision beyond the annotated pixels. Introducing the temporal consistency loss, L t ​ e ​ m ​ p L_{temp} further increases Dice to 0.812 0.812 on CAMUS and 0.790 0.790 on CardiacNet-PAH, indicating that coherence between neighboring frames provides valuable supervision. Finally, adding the gated-CRF loss, L C ​ R ​ F L_{CRF} improves CAMUS from 0.812 0.812 to 0.851 0.851 but reduces CardiacNet-PAH performance from 0.790 0.790 to 0.781 0.781 . This suggests that boundary-aware regularization is beneficial only when image boundaries provide reliable cues.
blocks.zh: 损失减少表明每个监督部分对两个数据集的贡献。 仅使用部分交叉性损失L p C E L_{pCE},得出CAMUS的Dice分数为0.613 0.613分,CADIAcNet-PAH的分数为0.410 0.410分,表明零散的书写说明含有不充分的监督信息. 加上一致性损失L c o n s L_{Q_{cons}使分解性能分别大幅提升到0.770 0.770和0.626 0.626,证明了在附加说明的像素之外利用伪标签监督的重要性. 引入时间一致性损失,L t e m p L_{temp}进一步将CAMUS上的Dice增加到0.812 0.812 和CardiacNet-PAH上的0.790 0.790 ,表明相邻框架之间的一致性提供了宝贵的监督. 最后,加上门式CRF损失,LC R F LQQCRF}将CAMUS从0.812 0.812提高到0.851 0.851,但将CardiacNet-PAH的性能从0.790 0.790降至0.781 0.781 0.781。 这表明,只有当图像边界提供可靠的提示时,了解边界的规范化才是有益的。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We propose a weakly-supervised framework for temporal echocardiography segmentation using only two scribbles on an anchor frame. By combining a mean-teacher framework, a LoRA-adapted DINOv3 encoder and connectivity-filtered pseudo-labels with spatial and temporal losses, supervision is propagated across unlabeled sequences. Experiments on CAMUS and CardiacNet demonstrate consistent improvements over existing scribble-supervised methods in Dice and HD95 while substantially reducing false-positive predictions. These results show that annotation cost can be decoupled from sequence length without sacrificing reliable temporal segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个弱监督的框架 时间回声心电图的分化 仅使用两个字 在锚架上。 通过结合一个中度教师框架、一个经LORA调整的DINOv3编码器和连接过滤的假标签以及空间和时间损失,监督被传播到没有标签的序列中。 在CAMUS和CardiacNet上的实验表明,与Dice和HD95中现有的有条理监督的方法相比,持续改进,同时大大减少了虚假的阳性预测。 这些结果显示,注释成本可以与序列长度脱钩,而不牺牲可靠的时间分解.
